duplicateTips.title: How to make sure you copied a different clip's link?
duplicateTips.id: Check the last 13 digits of the TikTok link. This number is a unique ID for each separate clip.

duplicateTips.noShort: Make sure you aren't using promotional shortened links.

waiting.title: How to boost your clip's views fast? (easy, proven tips)

items.title: Check the clip's privacy
items.text: Make sure the clip on TikTok is set to "Public", not "Private" or "Friends only", so everyone can see it.

items.title: Share the link for a strong start
items.text: Share the clip link in WhatsApp or Telegram groups to get the first views quickly and kick-start the algorithm.

items.title: Engage with the first comments
items.text: Replying to the first comments boosts engagement and pushes the platform to show your clip to a wider audience.

items.title: What does this error mean?
items.text: This is a temporary interruption on TikTok's side, not from your clip or account. It happens occasionally and is usually resolved within minutes.
items.footer: Clip is published and publicly available as normal

items.title: Will I lose my views or earnings?
items.text: No, never. All previous views and earnings are saved, and the system will update the counter as soon as the connection returns.

items.title: What should I do now?
items.text: Nothing. You can close the page and come back later, automatic retries continue on your behalf.
items.footer: Processing runs fully automatically in the background
